title: Sleep button on the power menu

clauses.text: the Sleep button and the s key put the computer to sleep, the screen locks, and the password is asked on wake

steps.do: Once a kernel with sleep support is installed, sign in, open the Power menu, choose Sleep (or press s).
steps.expect: The computer sleeps and the screen is locked.
The password is asked, and after it the same session comes back without a sign-in from scratch.
